newsitem.title: SWEDEN: TENNIS-INJURED GUSTAFSSON PULLS OUT OF STOCKHOLM OPEN.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-INJURED GUSTAFSSON PULLS OUT OF STOCKHOLM OPEN.

text.p: Sweden's Magnus Gustafsson, ranked number 17 in the world, pulled out of the Stockholm Open tennis on Wednesday because of a stomach muscle injury, a tournament official said.
Gustafsson would be replaced by South African qualifier Marcus Ondruska, 23, in a first-round match against Belgium's Filip Dewulf later on Wednesday, the official said.
Gustafsson was the number eight seed for the event, which started on Monday.
